# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-forties  <sub>[v1 c21 P44](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c21 P44](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>; Mrs. Stephen Irving  <sub>[v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>; Mother Lavendar  <sub>[v3 c23 P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Lavendar is a tiny, sweet-faced woman with snow-white, thick, wavy hair, pink cheeks, and dimples. She has big, soft, wood-brown eyes with golden glints that radiate warmth and youth. She loves to dress in dainty, ruffled, and frilly clothing such as delicate muslins.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Lavendar possesses an imaginative, romantic, and youthful nature, retaining an inner freshness despite her years. She is warm, hospitable, and deeply affectionate, though she admits to a streak of stubbornness or sulkiness when offended. Highly imaginative, she uses pretend play and daydreams as a comfort against loneliness.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## Goals

- To find companionship and love, escaping her long loneliness  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c23 P11](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0011)</sub>

## History

In her youth, Lavendar Lewis was engaged to Stephen Irving, but after a silly quarrel and her own stubborn refusal to forgive him immediately, Stephen left for the United States, leaving her broken-hearted. She settled into a quiet, secluded life at Echo Lodge in Grafton, keeping up her spirits by imagining companion friends and hiring a series of young maidservants whom she called Charlotta. Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon her home, discovering her setting a feast for imaginary guests, and they quickly became firm friends. Anne later introduced Stephen Irving's son, Paul, to Miss Lavendar, and eventually facilitated a reunion between Stephen and Miss Lavendar. The reunited lovers married under the honeysuckle arbor in her garden, after which they moved to Boston, returning to Echo Lodge to spend their summers.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c23 P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c28 P44](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0044), [v2 c28 P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent associated with her mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Engaged to Stephen Irving in her youth before a foolish misunderstanding separated them  <sub>[v2 c23 P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Lived for years in a secluded stone house called Echo Lodge with hired girls named Charlotta  <sub>[v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
